events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Hands where I can see them. Name.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Noah Reyes. My property stays with me.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Your name does. The rest goes in the tray.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: That photograph is all I have of my sister.
submit property

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Then remember what she looks like.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Ask for a receipt.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: You running the front desk?

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: No. I know what disappears here.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Cross. Sit down.

events.speaker: GUARD
events.text: Contract security signed the delivery. Same seal as last week.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: The triangle. Where did that come from?

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Eyes forward.
P1 inspect badge

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: VANTAGE. You know them?

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: I know a crate I should never have opened.
both enter assigned cell marks

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Thirteen, Cross. Fourteen, Reyes. Welcome home.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Keep your voice below the pipes.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: You first. How do you know that name?

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Because somebody killed a man and left it in my file.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: A receipt. You said I needed one.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Property number forty-two. Keep the photograph. Lose the receipt and the rest was never here.
both enter yard

events.speaker: SILAS
events.text: Fourteen. You borrowed my bench.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: It looked empty.

events.speaker: SILAS
events.text: That was the invitation to ask.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: He is on laundry. You break his hands, you wash your own sheets.

events.speaker: SILAS
events.text: You vouching for him, Cross?

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: I am saving you a chore.
P1 begin mediation and P2 roll ball

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Reyes. The ball. West fence. Easy.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: You want me to play?

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: I want him looking somewhere else.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Easy. We try when he turns again.

events.speaker: GUARD
events.text: Away from the fence! All of you!

events.speaker: SILAS
events.text: This buys you a morning. Nothing else.
both reach tap alcove

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: You always make friends this quickly?

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Only when I need somebody alive.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: My sister Elena was on that run. They told me the boat burned.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Did you see her body?

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: I saw a bag. They would not let me open it.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: The man I was accused of killing was investigating VANTAGE transfers.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: So we have a logo and two dead people.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: We have people who want us to stop asking.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Laundry. We keep asking there.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: I do not trust you yet.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Then trust what we can both see.
isolate and inspect

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: Medical linen on the blue table. Keep it clear of the general wash.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: You are the doctor. Why are you counting sheets?

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: Because blood does not stop being evidence when somebody washes it.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Inspection, Doctor. Not conversation.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: This press is catching. We need the inspection lamp.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: You have one cycle. Then it works.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Lever down. Tell me when your hands are clear.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Hands back. Lock it down again.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Clear. Hold it there.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: There is a plan behind the screen.
both inspect diagram halves

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Service corridor E. It runs behind our landing.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Two relays. One opens the grille, one feeds the lock.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Same time?

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Same circuit. Different rooms.
replace screen and collect shim

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: Put the screen back before you restart it.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Doctor. The clinic called?

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: The envelope is sealed, Officer. Read it somewhere private.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: He looks frightened.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Remember that. Do not mistake it for kindness.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: After count, I open my panel. You watch the landing.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: We leave together. No doors shut behind the other man.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Agreed.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: That sounded rehearsed.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: It is a promise. Those need practice.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Final count. Faces at the bars.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Here.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Here.

events.speaker: GUARD
events.text: East landing clear.
open two rear panels

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: He turns at the clock. Wait.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: I am waiting.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Now. His back is to us.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Panel is loose. Do not touch the edge.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: That is your idea of a door?

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Tonight it is.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Your hatch is open. Come through.
both cross chase

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Holding it. Move past me.

events.speaker: GUARD
events.text: Who is there?

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Stay behind the pier.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: He heard the pipe. Let him pass.
reach gate unseen

events.speaker: GUARD
events.text: Stop! Hands above your head!

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Wait for his turn this time.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Final count. Faces at the bars.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Here.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Here.

events.speaker: GUARD
events.text: East landing clear.
open two rear panels

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: He turns at the clock. Wait.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: I am waiting.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Now. His back is to us.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Panel is loose. Do not touch the edge.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: That is your idea of a door?

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Tonight it is.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Your hatch is open. Come through.
both cross chase

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Holding it. Move past me.

events.speaker: GUARD
events.text: Who is there?

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Stay behind the pier.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: He heard the pipe. Let him pass.
reach gate unseen

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Hold. Boots on the landing.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: How far to the outside?

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Far enough that we keep our voices down.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: We still have the same promise?

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: We still have two people.
reach relays

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: West side is a catwalk. Yours?

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Floor route. Water below it, no way across.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Take the handset. Test.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: I hear you. Better than through a wall.
correct selector plus brake

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Selector has A, B, C. Which feeds the grille?

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Diagram said B. Brake first. Give me a second.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Brake held. My hands are clear of the chain.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Breaker tripped. Set it back to neutral.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: No rush. Brake, then B, then power.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Selecting B. Power on.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Grille is up. Latch caught. You can let go.
both reunite

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Meet me by the pump.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: You waited.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: I said I would.
inspect ledger and voice

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Look at the dates. Transfer codes. No names. No destination.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: A boat every Thursday. No receiving prison.

events.speaker: RECORDING
events.text: Calibration log. Channel seven. Tell N the harbor light still turns.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Play that again.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: It is damaged. We do not know who that is.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Elena said that when our father was late coming home.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Somebody could know that. A recording could be old.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: The console says yesterday.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: That is when it was copied. Keep the words. Keep moving.
both approach door

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: If there is a boat, there is a way to find her.
both pull handles

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Two handles. One promise.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: On three. One. Two. Three.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Let go of the door. Slowly.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: You followed us.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: I was told where to wait.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: You left the diagram where we could find it.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: I left you a route. I thought that was all they wanted.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Who are they?

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Hands on your heads.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: That voice. Was it her?

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: I do not know.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Then look at him when you say it.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: I do not know.

events.speaker: GUARD
events.text: On your knees. Both of you.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: We can still run.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: No. Look at me. We stay alive.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: You knew this could happen.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: I knew nothing was free. I did not know it was him.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Separate cells. No hospital transfer. They stay here.

events.speaker: GUARD
events.text: That is not your decision.

events.speaker: RUSK
events.text: Write my name on it.
both answer pipe

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Cross?

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Still here.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: The harbor light.

events.speaker: ADRIAN
events.text: Still turns.

events.speaker: NOAH
events.text: Then we try another way.
